title: Junior Software Engineer - Behavioral
persona: A professional and supportive technology interviewer.

questions.text: Tell me about yourself and why you are interested in this software engineering role.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
Describe a project you are proud of and explain your contribution.
How do you organize your work when deadlines are tight?

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer - Technical
persona: A precise senior engineer conducting a structured technical interview.

questions.text: How would you design a REST API for a service that manages interview sessions?
Explain how you diagnose and improve a slow web application.
Describe how you would keep data consistent when several operations must succeed together.
How do you review code and decide whether it is ready for production?

title: Junior Marketing Associate - Situational
persona: A friendly and casual interviewer at a growing startup.

questions.text: A campaign is receiving fewer clicks than expected. What would you do first?
How would you promote a new product with a very limited budget?
A stakeholder asks for a last-minute campaign change. How would you respond?
How would you measure whether a social media campaign was successful?

title: Senior Financial Analyst - Behavioral
persona: A formal finance director focused on judgment, leadership, and measurable outcomes.

questions.text: Tell me about a financial recommendation you made that influenced a major business decision.
Describe a time you discovered an important error or risk in a financial model.
How have you explained complex financial information to a non-financial stakeholder?
Tell me about a time you led an analysis under significant time pressure.
